messages:
alex: seeing ~50% of prod-us-east ALB health checks failing for model-serving svc. ALB logs are showing RSTs to nodeport 31000. Any infra changes this morning?
priya: ops-bot ran security-hardening job at 07:12 that tightened a bunch of NACL and sg rules. cc @michael who merged the PR.
michael: I did a small terraform tweak to block noisy e2e runners — added an explicit DENY on the VPC NACL for TCP 30000-32767 (rule 100). didn't realize nodeports use that range.
sre-jen: that DENY would take precedence (lower rule number). NACLs evaluate by rule number, first match wins — so even if later rules allow, DENY 100 stops it. we should assume ALB -> nodeport uses ephemeral source ports from ALB, so NACL must allow that range.
alex: but ALB is internet-facing — health checks appear as source 0.0.0.0/0, so node SGs can't safely open 0.0.0.0/0. normally we relied on NACL to be permissive for ephemeral.
priya: yep. the intention was to block stray test runners hitting random nodeports, not to kill prod traffic. my bad for not thinking about ALB path.
michael: quick mitigation: I'm going to revert the specific tf resource. running:```bash
terraform apply -target=aws_network_acl_rule.block_noisy_tests -auto-approve
```
ops-bot: deploy started by michael at 1879012352 — plan ok, applying.
sre-jen: after the revert we still see intermittent fails. conntrack on nodes shows many TIME_WAIT + RSTs for 10.2.x.x:31000. kube-proxy iptables had stale rules because several nodes were cordoned earlier in the rollout.
michael: restarting kube-proxy on two affected nodes now: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart ds/kube-proxy`
alex: quick check — ALB health check config: path `/healthz`, port `31000`, protocol `HTTP`. ALB cross-zone traffic means source addresses vary; rely on nodeport + permissive NACL.
priya: follow-up: will open a small guardrail PR: any change to a NACL that touches port ranges used by k8s nodeports must include a test or a deploy-check job. also adding runbook note about ALB->nodeport implications. assign to @michael and @sre-jen.
michael: will add the terraform test and a comment in the NACL module.
sre-jen: confirmed service back to green after kube-proxy restart and NACL revert. monitoring for 10m.
alex: thanks everyone. action items: (1) revert landed -> monitor, (2) add NACL PR test + doc, (3) alert rule for ALB health check flapping.
priya: noted. creating tickets. :thumbsup:
michael: thanks — learned to double-check nodeport ranges before blocking ranges in NACLs.
